रञ्ज m. See जल-र्˚
रञ्जा f. a kind of drum, Saṃgīt.
रञ्जक mf(इका)n. colouring, dyeing, ŚārṅgS.
exciting passion or love, charming, pleasing, Cat.
रञ्जक m. a colourist, dyer, painter, Mn. iv, 216
an inciter of affection &c., stimulus, W.
the red powder on the capsules of the Rottleria Tinctoria, L.

रञ्जक n. cinnabar, L.
vermilion, L.
रञ्जकी f. a female colourer or dyer, Cat.
रञ्जन mf(ई)n. colouring, dyeing (-त्व n.), Sarvad.
(ifc.) pleasing, charming, rejoicing, delighting, Gīt. (cf. जन-रञ्जनी)
conciliating, befriending, MW.
रञ्जन m. Saccharum Munja, L.
रञ्जन n. the act of colouring or dyeing, Vāgbh.
colour, dye, paint, R.
(in gram.) nasalization, VPrāt., Sch.
the act of pleasing, delighting, conciliating, giving pleasure, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
a partic. game, L.
red sandalwood, L.
cinnabar, L.
रञ्जनी f. prob. friendly salutation, Buddh.
the indigo plant, L.
Nyctanthes Arbor Tristis, L.
turmeric, L.
saffron, L.
a kind of fragrant perfume, L.
red arsenic, L.
(in music) a partic. Śruti, Saṃgīt.
रञ्जन—त्व n.
रञ्जन—द्रव्य n. any colouring substance, Kum., Sch.
रञ्जन—द्रु m. a kind of tree, L.
रञ्जन—द्रुम m. Shorea Robusta, L.
रञ्जन—वल्ली f. Momordica Charantia, L.
रञ्जनक m. a kind of tree, L.
रञ्जनीय mfn. to be coloured or dyed, MW.
to be rejoiced or pleased or made happy, Kathās.
to be rejoiced at, pleasant, delightful, Sarvad.
रञ्जित mfn. coloured, dyed, painted, tinted, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
illumined, BhP.
